messages.subject: lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors!
parts:
Hi All,

Glad to see those who use lavaan have a community here. I am really excited to have joined here.

I am fitting a two-group CFA to my data. I'd like to estimate the factor mean differences between these two groups. So I set off to explore the factorial measurement invariance with ordinal data analysis a bit based on Millsap 2004, Assessing Factorial Invariance in Ordered-Categorical Measures.

But I keep on getting the warning messages "lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors! lavaan NOTE: this may be a symptom that the model is not identified." Please can you help me to troubleshoot? Thank you so much.

By the way, I specified the whole model explicitly to gain full control. So it's kind of lengthy. But most of them are just repetitious.

# Estimate Factor Mean Structures

myModel <- '# Factor Loadings
            # No Loadings Are Fixed in this Model
              f1 =~ c(NA, NA)*E1 + E2 + E14 + E27 + C31 + C32

              f5 =~ c(NA, NA)*V7 + V9 + V10 + V13 + V16 + V17 + V21 + V25 + V33

              f2~~ c(NA, NA)*f3+ c(NA, NA)*f4 + c(NA, NA)*f5 + c(NA, NA)*f6
              f3~~ c(NA, NA)*f4 + c(NA, NA)*f5 + c(NA, NA)*f6

              E1 | t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6

              C35 | t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6

              V10 | t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6
              V13 | t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6
              V16 | t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6
              V17 | t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6

              I12 | t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6
              I20 | t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6
              I23 | t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6
              I29 | t1 + t2 + t3 + t4 + t5 + t6
            '
fit <- lavaan(myModel,
              ordered = c("E1", "E2", "A3", "A4", "C5", "D6",
              "V7", "D8", "V9", "V10", "C11", "I12", "V13", "E14", "A15",
              "V16", "V17", "A18", "A19", "I20", "V21", "D22", "I23",
              "D24", "V25", "C26", "E27", "A28", "I29", "D30", "C31",
              "C32", "V33", "D34", "C35", "D36"),
              data = SATS_pre_post,
              group.equal = c("loadings", "intercepts", "thresholds"),
              group = "test",
              )
